title: Abbas Tere Baad
body:
abbas tere baad qayamat si bapa hai
<<DIVIDER>>
qaimo may ghareebon ke faqat ye hi sada
abbas tere baad qayamat si bapa hai
<<DIVIDER>>
pani na piya tashna rahe pani tha maujood
zinda tere kirdar hi se naame wafa hai
qaimo may ghareebon…
abbas tere baad…
<<DIVIDER>>
kya haal hua hoga mere ghazi ka us dam
jis dam ke bhare pani ka mashkeeza chida hai
qaimo may ghareebon…
abbas tere baad…
<<DIVIDER>>
bachon se yehi kehti rahi bali sakina
pani mera abbas chacha lene gaya hai
qaimo may ghareebon…
abbas tere baad…
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas e dilawar bhi suye khuld sidhaare
ahle haram e shah may kohraam bapa hai
qaimo may ghareebon…
abbas tere baad…
<<DIVIDER>>
hasrat hai ye shabbir ki ab bhai bhi kehdo
abbas ne ab tak to bas aaqa hi kaha hai
qaimo may ghareebon…
abbas tere baad…
<<DIVIDER>>
darya pe gaye laut ke wapas nahi aaye
baba mere ammu ko batayein jo huwa hai
qaimo may ghareebon…
abbas tere baad…
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas karayenge usay apni ziyarat
azhar ne is umeed pe ye noha kaha hai
qaimo may ghareebon…
abbas tere baad…
